# Code of Conduct

## The short version

Be decent. This is a small hobby project about a fantasy map; there is nothing
here worth being unpleasant to anyone over.

## What is expected

- Assume good faith. Most disagreements here are about a map position or a
  rendering quirk, not about anything that warrants heat.
- Criticise the work, not the person.
- Accept that "no" is a legitimate answer. The scope is deliberately small, and
  a declined idea is not a judgement of the person who suggested it.

## What is not acceptable

- Harassment, personal attacks, or demeaning comments — including about someone's
  identity, background, or beliefs.
- Sexual language or imagery.
- Publishing anyone's private information.
- Sustained disruption of issues or pull requests.

## Scope

This applies in the issues, pull requests, discussions, and commit history of
this repository, and to anyone representing the project elsewhere.

## Enforcement

Report problems to the maintainer privately via
[a security advisory](https://github.com/nooikko/post-map/security/advisories/new),
which is the private channel this repository has. Reports will be handled
discreetly.

As a single-maintainer hobby project there is no committee and no appeals
process. I will read what you send, act on it if it needs acting on, and tell
you what I did. Responses available to me are the ones GitHub gives me: a
warning, deleting comments, locking a thread, or blocking an account.

## Attribution

Adapted loosely from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org),
version 2.1, shortened to fit a project of this size.
